items.title: MyToolster
items.en_oneliner: A free collection of online developer tools — Unicode converter, URL tools, QR codes, and audio and video utilities, all usable right in the browser.

items.title: FreeLLM
items.en_oneliner: A directory of 500+ free LLM APIs from 31 providers including Google, Groq and OpenRouter, browsable by use case and model family — no more digging through docs to find a free API.

items.title: Show HN: Name the World – An Atlas Quiz
items.en_title: Show HN: Name the World – An Atlas Quiz
items.en_oneliner: Guess country names on a world map and learn where each one sits as you play.

items.title: Show HN: Craoli – describe a job in one sentence, it finds real postings
items.en_title: Craoli – describe the job you want in one sentence, it finds real postings
items.en_oneliner: Describe the job you want in one sentence and Craoli returns real, live postings — no more digging through job boards.

items.title: Show HN: Daybranch – Is this client request in scope?
items.en_title: Daybranch – Is this client request in scope?
items.en_oneliner: Bring in a client request from Slack or email and Daybranch checks it against your agreement, showing what is covered, what needs an estimate, and what to clarify.

items.title: MiniMax H3 Video Generator
items.en_oneliner: Generate short videos in your browser with the MiniMax H3 model — type a prompt or upload first and last frames to get a 4–15 second clip, with free trial credits on sign-up.

items.title: Show HN: Trichroma, a Platformer of Light
items.en_title: Trichroma, a Puzzle Platformer of Light
items.en_oneliner: Light the world with red, green and blue lamps: bridges and thorns exist only where their color falls, in a puzzle platformer with 11 chapters and 63 levels.

items.title: Show HN: Build a trading bot in 10 seconds
items.en_title: Build a trading bot in 10 seconds
items.en_oneliner: Describe a trade in plain words, see its rules as blocks, and run it right in the browser.

items.title: Show HN: SocialGTM – Find your first customers in conversations on social
items.en_title: SocialGTM – Find your first customers in conversations on social
items.en_oneliner: Social listening for X, Reddit, Hacker News, Bluesky, and LinkedIn: find people asking for a tool like yours, reply in your voice, and track every lead.

items.title: Show HN: Bellripple – a quiet Korean temple garden in the browser
items.en_title: Bellripple – a quiet Korean temple garden in the browser
items.en_oneliner: A quiet 3D temple garden in your browser. Walk, sit, bow, and ring the bell, alone or with others. Free, no account.

items.title: Show HN: Real-time clicker running on Elixir and a Raspberry Pi at home
items.en_title: Tug of War: Real-Time Global Clicker
items.en_oneliner: Play tug-of-war with the whole internet in real time: every click scores a point for the red or blue team, served from a Raspberry Pi at the author's home.

items.title: Show HN: ArkViz – AI generated software architecture diagrams
items.en_title: Show HN: ArkViz – AI generated software architecture diagrams
items.en_oneliner: AI turns your description into a clear software architecture diagram, making it easier to see how a system fits together.

items.title: Show HN: Holy Chip – organize home poker nights (RSVP, blinds timer, settle up)
items.en_title: Show HN: Holy Chip – organize home poker nights (RSVP, blinds timer, settle up)
items.en_oneliner: Run your home poker night in the browser: RSVPs, buy-ins, a blinds timer and settling up, with nothing to download.

items.title: Show HN: Out of Policy – Break an AI agent's spending guard for $75 USDC
items.en_title: Show HN: Out of Policy – Break an AI agent's spending guard for $75 USDC
items.en_oneliner: An adversarial game in the browser: talk an AI agent with a wallet into paying against its own spending rules — $75 if you crack it.
